title: card.resolved@1
description: Notification that a card reached a terminal state by a response or a cancel. By v1 convention the fields are ids and codes, with no free text (CW-20261023-0001); this is descriptive, not enforced by the catalog. The schema stays open: unknown fields and arbitrary strings validate. Enforcement is the producer's and Tachyon's server-side browser projection.

revision.description: Card revision this event describes; responses are compare-and-set on it.

card_type.description: Card type code (for example approval, form, notify). A code, not a title.

risk.description: Risk class code, computed server-side. Absent means the most restrictive class.

op_digest.description: Digest over the exact change set a card's effects may run, where the card has effects.

source_app.description: App that owns the card, derived from the verified credential subject, never self-asserted.

outcome.description: Outcome code: for example approved, denied, answered, canceled, superseded.

assurance.description: Assurance code recorded with the response, never the identity itself.
